title: NewsItem
description: Bronze record — one collection observation of a news item with provenance metadata; the body itself lives in news_body, referenced by hash (PRD ingestion, AC1.1-AC1.7).

record_id.description: Bronze tracking key; Silver/Gold join back to this (V5, AC2.6).

axis.description: Source axis tag — Korea / US / Global (AC1.3).

rank.description: Position within the source's top-N collection (AC1.2, AC1.5).

view_count.description: View count used for top-N ranking (AC1.5).

source_url.description: Original article link; always stored even if body capture fails (AC1.4).

body_hash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the captured body, resolving into bronze/news_body; empty string when the body could not be captured (AC1.4, AC1.7).

body_available.description: Whether the full body was captured (AC1.4).

collected_at.description: Collection timestamp; identifies the cycle time bucket (AC1.5).
